title: Childhood dream
content: I used to dream of this place all the time to the point it almost felt real. I would go with family to a park at night, I never remembered driving there or back it was like I was just there but the memories are so vivid it feels like it was not a dream but at the same time the landscape and surroundings were literally out of this world . There was always this older bald man and a little girl that my family and I would meet there . This playground was circular , a huge circular sandbox around that it was circled with grass . It seemed like almost you were on a planet in space . Or a floating disc . It was just the grass and the playground , looking off into the distance all you saw was a downward curve were the grass swooped drown . I could see the moon as well and the moon felt so close closer than on earth. I’m not sure how many time I had this dream but it stopped probably around age 12 . I have not dreamed of this specific location since then. I probably sound like I am not making any sense so I do apologize. But this whole dream never made since to me until this day. Has anyone else ever been here as a kid or even now ?
